function.description: Send ONE non-fungible token (NFT) you hold to an address. ⚠️ This is irreversible and always needs owner approval: a collectible has no reliable price, so no USD cap can bound what you are giving away. dry_run defaults to TRUE.
function.name: defi_trade_nft_transfer

amount.description: Quantity, erc1155 only. An erc721 is unique, so its amount must be 1.

chain.description:
Chain to nft_transfer on — CHOOSE IT DELIBERATELY, because the same address is a different token on a different chain. Chains that can move value: ethereum, base, robinhood, arbitrum, polygon. Gas differs by orders of magnitude, so a cent-scale trade can cost more in gas on ethereum than it is worth, while base is a fraction of a cent. Full guidance:
ethereum (id 1, gas ETH, swaps): Deepest liquidity and the canonical home of most ERC-20s, but the most expensive gas by far — an approve+swap+revoke cycle can cost more than a small trade is worth. Prefer it for size, for tokens that only exist here, or when depth matters more than fees.
base (id 8453, gas ETH, swaps): Cheap, fast L2 and the agent's own treasury chain: the USDC the wallet holds and the x402 payment rail both live here. The default choice for small trades, because gas is a fraction of a cent.
robinhood (id 4663, gas ETH, transfers): Robinhood's L2 (Arbitrum Orbit, ETH gas, gas ~free) and the primary memecoin hunting ground — minutes-old pools on the pons-v2 launchpad, real depth on the leaders. It also hosts TOKENIZED US EQUITIES (NVDA, AAPL, GME, SPY, SPCX) as ERC-20s, and memecoins here pair against WETH *or against a stock token* — so such a position is two bets stacked, the meme against its stock and the stock itself. The stablecoin is USDG, NOT USDC. No Uniswap V3 router is pinned, so everything routes through the aggregator; that is normal here, not a degraded path. Native ETH routes straight into a memecoin with no allowance, so ETH on this chain is gas and buying power at once.
robinhood-testnet (id 46630, gas ETH, data only): Robinhood Chain's TESTNET: valueless ETH, used to rehearse an agent-NFT collection (mint, adopt, inspect) before mainnet. Reads only here — nothing moves value from the agent on this chain, and no route, price or screen covers it.
arbitrum (id 42161, gas ETH, transfers): Cheap L2 with deep majors liquidity, and where the Hyperliquid venue settles. Gas is ETH and costs a fraction of a cent. No Uniswap V3 deployment is pinned here, so swaps route through the aggregator — which reaches Camelot, Ramses and the rest.
polygon (id 137, gas POL, transfers): Cheap chain with a large long-tail token market, and where the Polymarket venue settles. Gas is POL, NOT ether, and is far pricier per unit than an L2's — budget for it. No Uniswap V3 deployment is pinned here, so swaps route through the aggregator (QuickSwap, SushiSwap and the rest).
optimism (id 10, gas ETH, data only): OP Stack L2 with native USDC and deep majors liquidity; READ ONLY here (token screens, prices, balances). No money moves on this chain until the owner arms it. Gas is ETH and costs a fraction of a cent plus a small L1 data fee.
solana (id 0, gas SOL, data only): Solana. Reads (prices, screens, pool discovery, portfolio) work here; the EVM money verbs do NOT — swaps go through the dedicated defi_trade.solana_swap verb (Jupiter route, simulate-and-assert guard, SOLANA_TRADE_ENABLED) and sends through defi_trade.solana_transfer (SOL or an SPL token, same guard). Its addresses are base58 with NO checksum, so a mistyped one is a valid different account — verify before trusting any address here.

max_spend_usd.description: Ceiling for the transaction FEE. ⚠️ It does NOT bound the value of what you are sending — an NFT has no reliable price, which is why this verb always needs owner approval.

standard.description: erc721 (unique token) or erc1155 (semi-fungible). Say which — guessing would encode a call the contract may misread.
